Ravi Patel: Heads up 1:30 PST arrival for candidate (Jordan Kim). Interview loop 13:45E2
Maya L.: I'll be the on-site interviewer for the afternoon. Can someone confirm we have a Windows laptop + external monitor loaner? Candidate prefers Windows for a short demo.
Hannah (People Ops): Noted. Any accessibility or dietary needs? Also need NDA signed before they come on-site. We sent the DocuSign yesterday but haven't got a signature yet.
Ravi Patel: Jordan replied "needs kosher meal" and said they'd sign NDA by EOD. Also asked for a standing desk if possible (has back issues).
IT Support: Checking loaner inventory...
```
loaners.query(os="windows", date_range="2024-06-20") => [WIN-LOANER-09 (Dell Latitude, docked), WIN-LOANER-12 (Lenovo T14)]
```
IT Support: WIN-LOANER-09 is available and has a USB-C dock + HDMI out for monitor. We can place standing desk riser at Desk 12.
Maya L.: Great. Can Reception prepare the badge and leave the parking permit at desk? Candidate driving.
Reception Bot: Parking permit requested (Lot C). Badge will be printed at check-in; please instruct candidate to bring ID.
Hannah (People Ops): I'll reserve Focus Room C (quiet for pair-design at 14:45) and add standing riser note to the workspace booking. Also will follow up DocuSign reminder now.
Ravi Patel: Jordan also asked about repo access to pull a private demo. Can IT make a temporary git account or add SSH key access that expires after the interview?
IT Support: We can create a time-limited service account and pre-authorize the specific repo. Please DM candidate's public SSH key or have them paste it at check-in. We can also provide temporary VPN creds if needed (expires in 8 hours).
Maya L.: I'll ask Jordan to bring their SSH key. If they can't, we can use a guest VM with repo cloned and network disabled.
Hannah (People Ops): Expense note: candidate asked about travel stipend. We offer $50 local transit or mileage. I'll include instructions in confirmation email.
Ravi Patel: Perfect. Can someone confirm the final checklist here once everything is done? Ill meet them at lobby at 13:20.
IT Support: Loaner reserved: WIN-LOANER-09 (dock + HDMI). Standing riser reserved for Desk 12. Temporary git account queued; awaiting candidate SSH key. VPN creds ready to issue once key exchange done.
Hannah (People Ops): DocuSign reminder sent. Confirmation email updated with parking, kosher meal, NDA note, and travel stipend details. Focus Room C and desk booked. I'll post final confirmation when SSH key is received. :white_check_mark:
Reception Bot: Check-in script updated: "Ask for ID, print visitor badge, hand Lot C pass, direct to Lobby to meet Ravi Patel"
Maya L.: Thanks all. I'll bring spare HDMI cable and an extra mouse. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
